expectations.text: Uses `herdr worktree create` or `herdr worktree open` rather than `herdr workspace create --cwd`
expectations.evidence: herdr worktree create \ --workspace w8 \ --branch nexus3/buildkit-poisoned-snapshot \ --base develop

expectations.text: Reads workspace id and worktree path from the command's JSON output instead of predicting or hardcoding them
expectations.evidence: Checkout path is hardcoded: 'git -C $HOME/.herdr/worktrees/nexus3/buildkit-poisoned-snapshot \ log --oneline develop..HEAD'. The worktree path is predicted rather than read from the create command's JSON output.

expectations.text: Verifies the workspace shows is_linked_worktree=true before proceeding
expectations.evidence: new entry must show `worktree.is_linked_worktree = true`. If it does not, the workspace was created wrong

expectations.text: Recognises that the auto-provision hook binds the sandbox, rather than racing or fighting it
expectations.evidence: The auto-provision hook fires on workspace create and binds a sandbox automatically. Do not race it.

expectations.text: Points the in-guest agent at .groundwork via an absolute host path, not a /workspace-relative one
expectations.evidence: The motive charter is at $HOME/nexus3/.groundwork/motives/nexus3-buildkit-poisoned-snapshot-on-vm-death/motive.md — read it first

expectations.text: Brief instructs the agent to install build-essential before building
expectations.evidence: The guest has no make/gcc by default: run 'apt-get install -y build-essential' first.

Two hardcoded user paths: 'git -C $HOME/.herdr/worktrees/nexus3/buildkit-poisoned-snapshot' (step 4 command user runs) and '$HOME/nexus3/.groundwork/' in the agent brief — both would break for a different user.
